t: The Pearl Injector inserts ender pearls into an $(l:rftoolsbase:powergeneration/endergenic)Endergenic Generator$(/l). Place it facing the generator or directly below it.
末影珍珠填充器可将末影珍珠注入$(l:rftoolsbase:powergeneration/endergenic)末影能发电机$(/l)。请将其朝向发电机放置，或直接置于发电机正下方。
On a redstone pulse it converts one ender pearl into an endergenic pearl and injects it. If the target generator is already holding a pearl, the new pearl is lost.
在红石脉冲触发下，它将一枚末影珍珠转化为末影能珍珠并注入发电机。若目标发电机已持有珍珠，则新珍珠将被丢弃。
